A CDS&E proposal must be submitted to a participating Division according to the instructions below. A CDS&E proposal must be responsive to this Program Description, conform to all requirements and guidelines defined in the Proposal & Award Policies & Procedures Guide (PAPPG), and pertain to the scientific scope of the program or solicitation to which it is submitted. PIs are advised to check with the cognizant Program Officer(s) regarding questions of programmatic relevance. The due date for any CDS&E proposal is the due date for submission to the relevant Division or program defined in the table below; direct access to participating Program Descriptions is available through the links below. Proposals submitted to a specific program outside the proposal window or after the deadline or target date for the Division or program may be returned without review. PIs are advised to check with the cognizant Program Officer(s) if they plan to submit a proposal after a program's target date.
